correctness.rationale: Every fixed-space vector is fixed by a Frobenius-semilinear map; the minimal-dependence argument proves that independent binary fixed vectors are independent over the extension field even when M is singular. Exactly nk uniform-entry constraints yield the frame moments product_i(1-q^(i-n)); Gaussian-binomial inversion recovers all probabilities. The variance follows from the first two factorial moments. The uniform limiting bound uses a summable inversion coefficient series, and singular conditioning uses exact mixture subtraction at fixed q. The extracted verification code exhaustively matched exact laws in seven small cases, 70,422 matrices, without substituting finite checks for proof. Boundaries n=1 and d=n were checked.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The closest semilinear theorem gives deterministic normal forms and algebraic-closure fixed points, not the finite-field distribution for uniform possibly singular matrices; the 2026 theorem has narrower invertible support. General finite-field rank/corank laws cover the q=2 linear specialization, not the extension-field nonlinear squaring model uniformly in q.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The perfect model is conditional on det M != 0, with exact binary-GL_n fixed-space law and expectation one. Subtracting its invertible contribution from the newly obtained full law yields a new exact singular distribution and limit, despite singular matrices retaining positive limiting probability at fixed q.

originality.rationale: The published full-dimensional, all-field perfect-evolution-algebra idempotent law is expressly restricted to invertible structure matrices and has all frame moments equal to one. Here the unrestricted-model moments are distinct products of nontrivial q-dependent factors, and the singular-conditioned law and its limit need new information; the closest published claims do not entail them. The binary q=2 random-matrix corank specialization and classical limiting constant are acknowledged prior art. Searches cannot prove historical uniqueness, and survey full-text access was incomplete.
residual_risks: The complete motivating survey was inaccessible for direct full-text inspection in this run; the record and quotations from the inspected closest prior work were accessible.
Unindexed general random Frobenius-semilinear map results may already give an equivalent unrestricted law. No absolute priority claim is made.
The earlier October 2026 published perfect-algebra result was compared from indexed record/summary rather than complete main text; the later November 2026 stronger result was read completely.

value.rationale: Full matrix space is the natural uniformly labeled random evolution-algebra model. Exact probabilities at all n and all binary field sizes and the explicit singular-conditional law fill a substantive gap left by perfect-only censuses; the fixed-field singular population has nonzero asymptotic density, and its full idempotent law unexpectedly shares the perfect limit. These are distribution-level structural statistics motivated by a 2026 survey, not mere finite table recomputation or a claim of new classical fixed-space constants.
